description: PancakeBunny was exploited via flash loan price manipulation resulting in $45 million loss. The attacker borrowed massive BNB via flash loan from PancakeSwap, used it to buy large quantities of BUNNY tokens dramatically inflating the BUNNY/BNB price in the AMM pool. The protocol minting function used this manipulated spot price as oracle to mint new BUNNY tokens as yield rewards. The attacker received huge amounts of newly minted BUNNY tokens, immediately sold them all, repaid the flash loan, and kept the profit. The root cause is using on-chain AMM spot price as price oracle without time-weighted averaging TWAP, making it trivially manipulable within a single transaction.
